shared_training_path: every arm goes through cc_event_transfer.fit_arm; the only arm-dependent statements are the model factory and the burden state
normalisation: mean/sd estimated on training-event rows only, applied unchanged to validation and test
hgb_seed_determinism: HistGradientBoosting is deterministic at this sample size; its three seeds are one fit repeated, and are reported as one deterministic fit, not three replicates
